no.title: No
no.remarks: Indicates whether the response requires an answer in the negative.

actionby.title: Action By
actionby.remarks: The person who is assigned to complete the action.

hasscore.title: Score
hasscore.remarks: Indicates whether the item that is reviewed requires a score type of response.

score.title: Score
score.remarks: This response requires you to enter a score.

stdactdesc.title: Action Description
stdactdesc.remarks: A description of the action in the originating application.

actionbygroup.title: Action By Group
actionbygroup.remarks: The person group that is assigned to complete the action.

hasitems.title: Review Action
hasitems.remarks: Indicates whether action is a review.

reviewtype.title: Review Response Type
reviewtype.remarks: The type of review. Valid values are in the ALNDOMAIN.VALUE domain.

notapplicable.title: Not Applicable
notapplicable.remarks: Indicates that a response does not apply.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the log book.

class.title: Application
class.remarks: The application to which the record belongs that contains the actions.

origtable.title: The name of the Object for the action
origtable.remarks: The table that has generated the Action.

alphanumeric.title: Alphanumeric
alphanumeric.remarks: This response requires you to specify a number, an alphabetic or alphanumeric identifier, or any of these combinations.

sourceid.title: Source Action Identifier
sourceid.remarks: Source Action Identifier for relationship to Operations Action table.

yes.title: Yes
yes.remarks: Indicates whether the response requires an affirmative answer.

completed.title: Completed
completed.remarks: Specifies whether the action that is associated with the application record is complete.

isrevact.title: Review Action
isrevact.remarks: Indicates whether the action for the item must be reviewed.

recnum.title: Application Record
recnum.remarks: The identifier of the record in the originating application..

recordid.title: Record ID
recordid.remarks: The ID of the generating record.

stdactnum.title: Standard Action
stdactnum.remarks: The identifier of the action in the originating application. You can select an action or you can create an action using the Standard Actions application.

isalphanumeric.title: Numeric
isalphanumeric.remarks: Indicates whether the response for the item that is reviewed requires a number, an alphabetic or alphanumeric identifier, or any of these combinations.

origtabledesc.title: Action Source
origtabledesc.remarks: The action tab in the originating application where the action is found.

completeddate.title: Sign Off Date
completeddate.remarks: The date and time when the action is marked as completed.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the record in the originating application. You can create a query that searches for records that are in a particular status, such as approved.

yesorno.title: Yes or No
yesorno.remarks: Indicates whether the item that is reviewed requires a Yes or No answer.
